mapper.select: SELECT u.nickname, u.profilename, ip.info_content AS infoContent, ip.external_link, statistics.reviewNum, statistics.studentNum, statistics.reviewAvg FROM user AS u JOIN information_provider AS ip ON u.user_id = ip.information_provider_id JOIN (SELECT u.nickname, COUNT(r.review_id) AS reviewNum, SUM(l.student_num) AS studentNum, AVG(r.review_rate) AS reviewAvg FROM user AS u JOIN information_provider AS ip ON u.user_id = ip.information_provider_id JOIN lecture AS l ON u.user_id = l.uploader_id JOIN review AS r ON r.lecture_id = l.lecture_id GROUP BY u.user_id) AS statistics ON u.nickname = statistics.nickname WHERE u.user_id = #{userId};
SELECT ip.information_provider_id AS providerId, u.nickname, u.profileName FROM user AS u JOIN information_provider AS ip ON u.user_id = ip.information_provider_id

SELECT l.lecture_id lectureId, l.thumbnail thumbnail, l.name title, u.nickname nickname, l.introduction introduction, l.price price, l.discount_rate discountRate, COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) reviewNum, COALESCE(SUM(r.review_rate), 0) totalReviewRate, COALESCE(SUM(r.review_rate), 0) / COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) avgReviewRate, COUNT(lb.user_id) bookmarkNum, l.difficulty difficulty FROM lecture l left JOIN lecture_bookmark lb ON lb.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN user u ON l.uploader_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN review r ON r.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN information_provider AS ip ON u.user_id = ip.information_provider_id WHERE l.uploader_id = #{userId} GROUP BY l.lecture_id;

SELECT ip.information_provider_id as providerId, u.profilename as profileName, u.nickname as nickname, ip.info_content as infoContent, COALESCE(r.avg_rating, 0.0) as avgReviewRate, COALESCE(r.review_count, 0) as reviewNum, COALESCE(b.bookmark_count, 0) as bookmarkNum, COALESCE(l.lecture_count, 0) as lectureNum FROM information_provider ip INNER JOIN information_provider_bookmark pb ON ip.information_provider_id = pb.information_provider_id LEFT JOIN user u ON ip.information_provider_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ip.information_provider_id, COUNT(*) as review_count, AVG(CAST(r.review_rate AS DECIMAL(3, 2))) as avg_rating FROM information_provider ip LEFT JOIN lecture l ON ip.information_provider_id = l.uploader_id LEFT JOIN review r ON l.lecture_id = r.lecture_id GROUP BY ip.information_provider_id) r ON ip.information_provider_id = r.information_provider_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT information_provider_id, COUNT(*) as bookmark_count FROM information_provider_bookmark GROUP BY information_provider_id) b ON ip.information_provider_id = b.information_provider_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ip.information_provider_id, COUNT(l.lecture_id) as lecture_count FROM information_provider ip LEFT JOIN lecture l ON ip.information_provider_id = l.uploader_id GROUP BY ip.information_provider_id) l ON ip.information_provider_id = l.information_provider_id WHERE pb.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ip.information_provider_id as providerId, u.profilename as profileName, u.nickname as nickname, ip.info_content as infoContent, COALESCE(r.avg_rating, 0.0) as avgReviewRate, COALESCE(r.review_count, 0) as reviewNum, COALESCE(b.bookmark_count, 0) as bookmarkNum, COALESCE(l.lecture_count, 0) as lectureNum FROM information_provider ip INNER JOIN information_provider_bookmark pb ON ip.information_provider_id = pb.information_provider_id LEFT JOIN user u ON ip.information_provider_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ip.information_provider_id, COUNT(*) as review_count, AVG(CAST(r.review_rate AS DECIMAL(3,2))) as avg_rating FROM information_provider ip LEFT JOIN lecture l ON ip.information_provider_id = l.uploader_id LEFT JOIN review r ON l.lecture_id = r.lecture_id GROUP BY ip.information_provider_id ) r ON ip.information_provider_id = r.information_provider_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT information_provider_id, COUNT(*) as bookmark_count FROM information_provider_bookmark GROUP BY information_provider_id ) b ON ip.information_provider_id = b.information_provider_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ip.information_provider_id, COUNT(l.lecture_id) as lecture_count FROM information_provider ip LEFT JOIN lecture l ON ip.information_provider_id = l.uploader_id GROUP BY ip.information_provider_id ) l ON ip.information_provider_id = l.information_provider_id WHERE pb.user_id = #{userId}
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.user_id as userID, u.profilename as profileURL, u.nickname as nickname, ip.external_link as externalLink, ip.info_content as infoContent FROM information_provider ip JOIN user u ON ip.information_provider_id = u.user_id where ip.information_provider_id = #{userId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_request (information_provider_id, legal_name, nickname, info_content, external_link, approval_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{nickname}, #{intro}, #{externallink}, null)
INSERT INTO supporting_material (user_id, career, fileURL) VALUES (#{promotionRequestId}, #{text}, #{fileUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id as userId, career as text, fileURL as fileUrl FROM supporting_material WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id ASC
